title: [DEMO] Website Example — 3-Bedroom, 2-Bath Northwoods Cabin
scope: Plan a 1,248-square-foot, single-story, three-bedroom, two-bath northern Minnesota cabin on an uncleared rural lot, excluding land purchase.

lines.description: 20-EXTERIOR — Covered Entry, Steps and Exterior Completion

subQuotes.title: Survey, Soils and Preconstruction
subQuotes.scope: Boundary/topographic survey allowance, soils and bearing review, septic soil evaluation, utility research, staking and preconstruction coordination.

subQuotes.title: Clearing, Grading and Driveway
subQuotes.scope: Selective clearing, stump removal, debris handling, erosion control, rough grading, building pad, approximately 250 ft Class 5 access drive, drainage and final shaping.

subQuotes.title: Private Well
subQuotes.scope: Licensed well contractor allowance including drilling, casing, grout, pump, pressure system, trench to cabin, notification, well record and initial water testing.

subQuotes.title: Septic / SSTS
subQuotes.scope: Three-bedroom licensed design basis, tank, distribution, trench or bed allowance, piping, installation, inspection and as-built record. Mound upgrade excluded.

subQuotes.title: Utility Service and Exterior Trenching
subQuotes.scope: Electrical service coordination, transformer/service allowance, trenching, conduit, meter equipment and exterior connections, subject to actual utility distance.

subQuotes.title: House Plans, Engineering and Permits
subQuotes.scope: Dimensioned floor plan, elevations, foundation and framing details, structural and energy review allowances, mechanical layouts, permit drawings, review and permit allowances.

subQuotes.title: Insulated Slab Foundation
subQuotes.scope: Excavation, compacted base, frost protection, insulation, vapor barrier, reinforcing, thickened edges, under-slab plumbing coordination and concrete finish.

subQuotes.title: Framing and Structural Shell
subQuotes.scope: Exterior and interior framing, engineered roof package, sheathing, connectors, blocking, labor, equipment and dry-in coordination.

subQuotes.title: Roofing
subQuotes.scope: Underlayment, ice and water protection, asphalt shingles, flashing, ventilation, drip edge and gutter allowance.

subQuotes.title: Windows and Exterior Doors
subQuotes.scope: Cold-climate window package, insulated exterior doors, flashing, air sealing, hardware and installation.

subQuotes.title: Siding and Exterior Finish
subQuotes.scope: Weather-resistive barrier, durable siding, trim, soffit, fascia, exterior sealants and finish details.

subQuotes.title: Insulation and Air Sealing
subQuotes.scope: Code-compliant wall, roof and slab package, penetration sealing, blower-door readiness and energy documentation allowance.

subQuotes.title: Electrical
subQuotes.scope: 200-amp service and panel, branch wiring, AFCI/GFCI protection, lighting, receptacles, smoke/CO alarms, appliance circuits, exterior outlets, low-voltage allowance, permits and inspections.

subQuotes.title: Plumbing
subQuotes.scope: Well-to-house connection, underground and above-floor DWV, water distribution, two bathrooms, kitchen, laundry, water heater, fixtures allowance, testing, permits and inspections.

subQuotes.title: HVAC and Ventilation
subQuotes.scope: Cold-climate heat pump or equivalent, backup heat, load calculation allowance, distribution, bath exhaust, range ventilation, ERV, controls, startup, balancing, permits and inspections.

subQuotes.title: Drywall and Painting
subQuotes.scope: Drywall, finishing, selected texture, primer, interior paint and touch-up.

subQuotes.title: Cabinets and Countertops
subQuotes.scope: Mid-range kitchen cabinetry, bath vanities, hardware, quartz or comparable countertop allowance, installation and templates.

subQuotes.title: Flooring, Trim and Interior Doors
subQuotes.scope: Durable flooring, bedroom flooring allowance, interior doors, casing, base, closet shelving and finish carpentry.

subQuotes.title: Fixtures and Appliances
subQuotes.scope: Plumbing fixture allowance, lighting fixture allowance, kitchen appliance package, bath accessories and installation coordination.

subQuotes.title: Covered Entry, Steps and Exterior Completion
subQuotes.scope: Covered entry structure, steps and landing, railings as required, final grading, topsoil and seed allowance and construction cleanup.

subQuotes.title: General Conditions and Project Management
subQuotes.scope: Scheduling, procurement, temporary power and sanitation, dumpsters, site protection, supervision, quality checks, documentation, inspections, closeout and overhead allowance.
